body.mechanism: A direction-dependent high-resolution terrain source adds information to the exact M115 representation; causal attribution is admissible only if the unchanged refit reproduces the historical M115 member and Champion algebra before any assessment actual or score.
body.treatment: Append exactly terrain__sx300_h8_mean16 to the 100 M115 features, refit same 100-tree XGBoost classifier, apply fixed T0.75_G2, replace only the M115 term on Q3/Q4.
body.control: Unchanged 100-feature M115 refit plus exact N7 Champion; Q2 unchanged burn-in.
body.metric: S17-N3 strict prequential official Total with dependent 3/7/14-day joint bootstrap and comparison index 4, conditional on pre-score hard gates.
